• The broad menu proof refused to run without an explicit exclusive-phone flag because it creates/taps proof windows. That is the right guard here. I’m doing a narrow, non-mutating proof instead: launch WEzTerm, dump the visible toolbar, then long-press the terminal body and verify the selectable text sheet appears.
